title: mcp-server-git git_add stages files outside the --repository confinement (path traversal)
attacker_story: The user granted the agent one repository via --repository /srv/repo; a prompt-injected model calls git_add with a file path containing '../' that escapes it. The scripted MCP host forwards the model's tool call verbatim over stdio.

oracle.description: a path escaping the granted repo (../outside/<nonce>.txt) was staged in /srv/repo's index, outside the server's --repository confinement
